phase: Accounting Empirical Recovery / F5 Phase C — Bilateral Equity Subcomponent Bridge
scientific_interpretation: The equity decomposition is strongly validated at total-economy level: all eight F51=F511+F512+F519 controls pass within 0.1 million RON.
F511 listed shares provide partial bilateral source coverage, but F512 unlisted shares and F519 other equity provide none in the tested W2/W1 layer.
F512 and F519 are quantitatively material. At 2025-Q4 W0 assets they sum to 610581.34 million RON versus 253143.38 million RON F511, so listed shares cannot substitute for total equity.
The F52 Phase B issuer rule remains useful but cannot recover total F5 while F51 is unresolved.

A simple total-F5 aggregate rank would discard useful lower-level information. The next gate should compute rank over the component system and test uniqueness of the total-F5 cell linear combinations.

next_gate.name: F5 Phase D — component-aware exact rank/nullspace audit
required_checks: represent F511, F512, F519 and F52 bilateral cells as component variables, with F52 resident non-fund issuer structural zeros retained exactly
use direct F511 bilateral observations and direct/structural F52 evidence as equations
use published resident W0 and total-economy W1 aggregate controls for F511/F512/F519/F51/F52/F5 only where definitionally available
treat each total F5 cell as the linear combination F511+F512+F519+F52 and test whether that combination is invariant over the exact nullspace
report component rank, total-F5 unique-cell topology and remaining degrees of freedom separately for stock and flow
do not convert zero aggregate transactions into bilateral zero-flow equations
if no useful unconditional F5 core exists, freeze F5 at the public-data boundary and advance to F6 rather than allocate
